body.name: endpointBox
body.def: \(\mathcal C_{\rm end}=[L_{\rm lo},L_{\rm hi}]\times[U_{\rm lo},U_{\rm hi}]\), where \(L_{\rm lo}=\max_{f\in\mathfrak F^-_T}\{f(\widehat p)-\varepsilon_f\}\), \(L_{\rm hi}=\max_{f\in\mathfrak F^-_T}\{f(\widehat p)+\varepsilon_f\}\), \(U_{\rm lo}=\min_{f\in\mathfrak F^+_T}\{f(\widehat p)-\varepsilon_f\}\), and \(U_{\rm hi}=\min_{f\in\mathfrak F^+_T}\{f(\widehat p)+\varepsilon_f\}\).
